chapter: England, Paris and memories of Kansas City and Harlem
title: Meeting Thelonious Monk in Kansas City in 1930
summary: She met Monk, travelling with a medicine show, at a Kansas City club called the Subway. Nobody understood his playing, yet Lester Young and Basie went to hear him.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: When did you first meet Thelonious Monk?

I think it was the year of 1930 in Kansas City. He was traveling with a show somewhat like a medicine show. The music was so great in Kansas City so he stopped off there. They had opened up a new night club called the Subway or something like that in Kansas City and I met Monk there and he was playing the same way he plays now. No one understood it. I used to hang out with him and we became great friends then. During that period Lester Young, Herschel Evans, and Count Basie and all the musicians used to go down to the Subway to hear Monk play.
What happened to music in Kansas City because of Monk?

I don't think the music changed too much as far as Monk was concerned. Everybody in Kansas City you must remember were playing different sounds, you know. They were playing in their own individual styles.
